de1.P1.C11.explanation:
Ta có: $\underset{x\to -\infty }{\lim}\,\left( \sqrt{{{x}^{2}}-x+1}+x-2 \right)$ $=\underset{x\to -\infty }{\lim}\,\frac{{{x}^{2}}-x+1-{{\left( x-2 \right)}^{2}}}{\sqrt{{{x}^{2}}-x+1}-\left( x-2 \right)}$ $=\underset{x\to -\infty }{\lim}\,\frac{3x-3}{\sqrt{{{x}^{2}}-x+1}-x+2}$ $=\underset{x\to -\infty }{\lim}\,\frac{3-\frac{3}{x}}{-\sqrt{1-\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{{x}^{2}}}}-1+\frac{2}{x}}$ $=-\frac{3}{2}$ $\Rightarrow $ đáp án A đúng.
$\underset{x\to +\infty }{\lim}\,\left( \sqrt{{{x}^{2}}-x+1}+x-2 \right)=\underset{x\to +\infty }{\lim}\,x\left( \sqrt{1-\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{{x}^{2}}}}+1-\frac{2}{x} \right)$.
Do $\underset{x\to +\infty }{\lim}\,x=+\infty $ và $\underset{x\to +\infty }{\lim}\,\left( \sqrt{1-\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{{x}^{2}}}}+1-\frac{2}{x} \right)=2>0$ nên $\underset{x\to +\infty }{\lim}\,x\left( \sqrt{1-\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{{x}^{2}}}}+1-\frac{2}{x} \right)=+\infty $ $\Rightarrow $ đáp án C đúng.
Do $\underset{x\to -{{1}^{-}}}{\lim}\,\left( 3x+2 \right)=-1<0$ và $x+1<0$ với $\forall x<-1$ nên $\underset{x\to -{{1}^{-}}}{\lim}\,\frac{3x+2}{x+1}=+\infty $ $\Rightarrow $ đáp án B sai.
Do $\underset{x\to -{{1}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\left( 3x+2 \right)=-1<0$ và $x+1>0$ với $\forall x>-1$ nên $\underset{x\to -{{1}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\frac{3x+2}{x+1}=-\infty $ $\Rightarrow $ đáp án D đúng.

de2.P1.C10.explanation:
Ta có:
$\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,f\left( x \right)=\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\frac{\sqrt{x+4}-2}{x}$ $=\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\frac{\left( x+4 \right)-{{2}^{2}}}{x\left( \sqrt{x+4}+2 \right)}$ $=\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\frac{x}{x\left( \sqrt{x+4}+2 \right)}$ $=\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{x+4}+2}=\frac{1}{4}$.
$\underset{x\to {{0}^{-}}}{\lim}\,f\left( x \right)=\underset{x\to {{0}^{-}}}{\lim}\,\left( mx+m+\frac{1}{4} \right)=m+\frac{1}{4}$
Hàm số đã cho có giới hạn tại $x=0$ khi và chỉ khi $\underset{x\to {{0}^{+}}}{\lim}\,f\left( x \right)=\underset{x\to {{0}^{-}}}{\lim}\,f\left( x \right)$
$\Rightarrow m+\frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{4}$, tức $m=0$.
